scenes.heading: Running effective coaching sessions clients actually value

sents.d: Running effective coaching sessions clients actually value
Structure and accountability tend to matter more to clients than conversational flexibility.

Coaching sessions with no consistent structure can feel pleasant but directionless to clients over time — a repeatable session structure (reviewing progress since last time, discussing the current focus, agreeing on next steps) gives clients a sense of forward motion.
Ending every session with specific, written action items — not just verbal agreement — significantly increases the odds clients actually follow through before the next session.

Taking brief notes during or immediately after each session protects continuity, especially across many clients, and shows clients you remember and track their specific situation rather than treating every session as generic.

take: Structure sessions and end with written next steps.
